target.title: fix(googlechat): preserve inbound attachments
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Google Chat inbound processing read only the first attachment. If that download failed after the webhook had already acknowledged the message, the exception stopped the pipeline and the acknowledged text was never sent to the agent. Later attachments were also silently ignored.

## Why This Change Was Made

Inbound processing now handles every attachment independently. Successfully downloaded files are all included in the inbound context in message order. A download or save failure is logged and does not prevent later attachments or the message text from reaching the agent pipeline.

## User Impact

Google Chat messages retain all downloadable attachments. A transient or invalid attachment no longer causes an otherwise valid, already-acknowledged message to disappear.

## Evidence

- Added regression coverage for two successful attachments and for a failed first attachment followed by a successful second attachment; the latter verifies that text still enters the inbound run.
- `node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts extensions/googlechat/src/monitor.test.ts extensions/googlechat/src/monitor-webhook.test.ts` (30 passed)
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs extensions/googlechat/src/monitor.ts extensions/googlechat/src/monitor.test.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write extensions/googlechat/src/monitor.ts extensions/googlechat/src/monitor.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --output /tmp/openclaw-autoreview/googlechat-attachment-ingestion.json` (clean; no accepted/actionable findings)

Remote Testbox validation is unavailable in this environment because the current account is not authenticated to the `openclaw` organization. The focused test is therefore a narrow local fallback; GitHub CI remains the remote validation path.
